scroll-table-of-contents.sourceHtml:
FIELD MANUAL / CONTENTS01 / 04
01 / PREMISE

The useful edge

An interface becomes legible at its boundaries. The edge tells us where one action ends, where another begins, and what can still be moved.

READING TIME / 01:20
02 / MATERIAL

Weight and reply

A surface should answer input with a material logic of its own: resistance, momentum, compression, or a quiet change of state.

READING TIME / 02:10
03 / RHYTHM

Intervals matter

Timing creates hierarchy. A short pause can separate cause from effect; a stagger can turn a group into an ordered sequence.

READING TIME / 01:45
04 / PRACTICE

Test the gesture

The final measure is not novelty but comprehension. If motion makes the next action easier to predict, it has earned its place.

READING TIME / 01:05

CONTENTS

Section 1 — Premise

blocks.text: An interface becomes legible at its boundaries. The edge tells us where one action ends, where another begins, and what can still be moved.
A surface should answer input with a material logic of its own: resistance, momentum, compression, or a quiet change of state.
Timing creates hierarchy. A short pause can separate cause from effect; a stagger can turn a group into an ordered sequence.
The final measure is not novelty but comprehension. If motion makes the next action easier to predict, it has earned its place.
